watch._doc: Section 6.3: the LOGGED meter per player (WatchMeter). Rates per second unless noted. pool_radius: his lantern's pool; sweep: the Lantern Sweep cone; sight_m: how far he logs by sight; look_cone_deg: 'looking straight at him'; teammate_m: the drain's radius. noisy_zones: firing an unsuppressed weapon there logs +2 a shot (the pen hall's echo stands in for Morgenrot's forest).

lights._doc: Section 6.5 at Totenhafen: he can only be damaged while lit. pools: [x, y, z, radius, needs_power] (the quay floods, the pen hall's key light and wall floods, the catwalk bulkheads, the pole lamps; gen_map02.gd). searchlight_nodes: SpotLight3D nodes whose cone lights him (the signal tower's battery lamp, and C2's manned Searchlight if it exists in the 'searchlights' group). levers: the three fuse boxes that relight a pool group after End of Shift (a 5 s hold each).

doors._doc: He locks these as he walks past (within lock_radius): the Pen Hall doors and the pump stair. A locked door re-opens for free when he leaves its zone (outside every box and farther than unlock_m) or dies, or leaves the map. box: [min xyz, max xyz].

route._doc: His rounds when nobody is in sight: the pen hall's catwalks, the pump stair and the quay (navmesh points from smoke_map02's checks; gen_map02.gd).

exit._doc: The fail-safe: he walks to the quay's east surf steps and off the edge into the storm (the rails don't stop him).

ARC_HB_SLENDER.title: THE SLENDER
ARC_HB_SLENDER.text: The Hafenwaechter: the pens' night watchman, a tall, thin, quiet man who took the overnight shift every night because he liked the silence and the harbour lights. He walked the catwalks with a lantern and a ring of keys, logged every boat and every light in a thick watch-book, and on the night of the Erwachen he locked every door behind him so the dead would stay in the pens. The Marke kept him walking. Nothing got past him. Inspired by Devin.

INT_HB_04.title: The Watch-Book
INT_HB_04.text: A thick bound book set down on the quay under a cold lantern. The flyleaf: "Property of %DEVIN_LASTNAME% Night Watch, Totenhafen pens." Every hour of every night in a perfect hand. The last pages are about you.

lines._doc: Section 8 (8.1 the Operator, 8.4 THE SLENDER, 8.5 the squad). Baked placeholder TTS in data/gravelight/vo/lines.json takes over when present; else the subtitle shows silently. speaker SLN = the boss (shown per Homage Names).

SLN_ARRIVE_01.speaker: SLN
SLN_ARRIVE_01.text: Evening. Don't mind me. I'm only on my rounds.

SLN_WRITE_02.speaker: SLN
SLN_WRITE_02.text: ...stood very still. Thought I wouldn't see.

SLN_MIRROR_01.speaker: SLN
SLN_MIRROR_01.text: You stop, I stop. That's only manners.

SLN_MIRROR_STEP_01.speaker: SLN
SLN_MIRROR_STEP_01.text: You walked that way. I know. I was just behind you.

SLN_SWEEP_01.speaker: SLN
SLN_SWEEP_01.text: Let's have a look at you.

SLN_ROOM_01.speaker: SLN
SLN_ROOM_01.text: Everyone has a page. Find yours.

SLN_ROOM_02.speaker: SLN
SLN_ROOM_02.text: It's three o'clock. It's always three o'clock in here.

SLN_DARK_01.speaker: SLN
SLN_DARK_01.text: Lights out. Last round of the night.

SLN_LEAVE_01.speaker: SLN
SLN_LEAVE_01.text: Rounds aren't finished. I'll be back this way.

SLN_DEATH_01.speaker: SLN
SLN_DEATH_01.text: ...Shift's over. Someone else has the watch now.

OPR_BOSS_SLENDER_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_BOSS_SLENDER_01.text: Attention, valued customers: the night {shift} is now on duty. Please have your {papers} ready.

OPR_BOSS_SLENDER_02.speaker: OPR
OPR_BOSS_SLENDER_02.text: Our {watchman} has never missed a night. Not {one}. Do try not to be {noticed}!

OPR_BOSS_SLENDER_03.speaker: OPR
OPR_BOSS_SLENDER_03.text: Shift {change}! Three for the price of {one}!

OPR_BOSS_SLENDER_04.speaker: OPR
OPR_BOSS_SLENDER_04.text: We are experiencing a brief {outage}. Please remain where you can be {seen}.

OPR_BOSS_SLENDER_QUAR_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_BOSS_SLENDER_QUAR_01.text: A {customer} has been taken in for {review}.

OPR_BOSS_SLENDER_LEFT_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_BOSS_SLENDER_LEFT_01.text: The watch is... {rescheduled}. He'll be by again. He's always {by}.

OPR_BOSS_SLENDER_DEAD_01.speaker: OPR
OPR_BOSS_SLENDER_DEAD_01.text: The night watch has clocked {out}! And dawn is... {closer} than you think.

DUT_SLENDER_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_SLENDER_01.text: Tall fella with a lantern. Just watching. I hate the ones that just watch.

DUT_SLENDER_02.speaker: DUT
DUT_SLENDER_02.text: He's writing. He's writing about ME.

DUT_QUARANTINE_01.speaker: DUT
DUT_QUARANTINE_01.text: Room full of books and a clock that don't move. I'm never goin' in a library again.

PEG_SLENDER_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SLENDER_01.text: He only bleeds in the light. Bring him to the floodlights. Politely.

PEG_SLENDER_02.speaker: PEG
PEG_SLENDER_02.text: Three of him. Watch the lanterns. The steady one's real.

PEG_QUARANTINE_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_QUARANTINE_01.text: A clerk's office with no clerk. I've been interrogated in worse.

PEG_SLENDER_DEAD_01.speaker: PEG
PEG_SLENDER_DEAD_01.text: A man who kept his post when everyone else ran. I've known worse men in better uniforms.

DEA_SLENDER_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SLENDER_01.text: He's just doing his rounds. Lord, he's been doing his rounds this whole time.

DEA_QUARANTINE_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_QUARANTINE_01.text: Clock stopped at three. Mama always said nothing good happens after three.

DEA_SLENDER_DEAD_01.speaker: DEA
DEA_SLENDER_DEAD_01.text: Rest easy, watchman. We'll keep the lights on.

WRN_SLENDER_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_SLENDER_01.text: He stops when I stop. He turns when I turn. ...Good. I can count on him.

WRN_SLENDER_02.speaker: WRN
WRN_SLENDER_02.text: The book! Shoot the book out of his hands!

WRN_QUARANTINE_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_QUARANTINE_01.text: My page was neat. He has better handwriting than me.

WRN_SLENDER_DEAD_01.speaker: WRN
WRN_SLENDER_DEAD_01.text: He wrote everything down. Every hour. ...I understand him.

the_slender._doc_rework: T-233 (docs/BOSS_REWORK.md 4.1, docs/boss_rework/w3_totenhafen.md): the boss rework. dread: the kit's presence block (radius 24: he is felt from far; surface cloth; a quiet step: no stomp, no shake). moves.mirror: the Mirroring step (step_*): the keys go still for step_silence s, then he stands where the target stood step_delay_s ago (within step_min_range..range, in sight), and stands still step_hold s after it (a clean shot); step_cooldown by phase. phases: per-phase overrides of a move's numbers ('2' from Shift Change, '3' from End of Shift): the sweep's cooldown 12 -> 9 -> 7, the Mirroring step's cooldown 14 -> 10 -> 7, the Lash's range 4 -> 4 -> 5, his walk 1.6 -> 1.6 -> 1.9 (a walk still: he never runs). watch.alone_dark_mult: a lone player (no teammate within teammate_m) in the dark fills every positive source x1.5. whisper: slender_whisper close to a player by tier (seconds between whispers per tier NONE..CRITICAL; 0 = none); hurt_fraction: a player under that HP fraction hears it from LOW every hurt_tier_s; breath_m / breath_s: boss_breath when he stands over you. end_of_shift.fuse_spark_s: the fuse boxes spark every so often while the lights are out; dim_fade: how long the lamps take to die.

phases._doc: Per-phase overrides (phase 2 from Shift Change, 3 from End of Shift) read by Slender._mvf: moves.<move>.<key> and 'speed'.

der_kielholer._doc: Kptlt. Arvid Lenz in the harbour's salvage diving dress (design 4). hp_base 28000: between the Kranfuehrer (24000, a rail boss you can't reach half the time) and PAUL (30000): he spends ~20% of the fight under water (three submerges of 6-10 s), so his effective time-to-kill matches a 30000 boss that is always up. Weak points: helmet_glass x1.0 until helmet_break_fraction of max HP has been taken, then it breaks (a roar) and the violet glow behind it (the Marke he wears under the glass) takes x2.0; the back of the suit where the chain rubs x1.3. submerge_every: he goes under each time another quarter of his HP is gone (75/50/25 %), invulnerable, and surfaces at another dock after submerge_seconds with a ripple telegraph of ripple_seconds. At high and spring tide he is tide_speed_mult faster and surfaces at the dock nearest his target.
der_kielholer.title: DER KIELHOLER
der_kielholer.subtitle: Kapitänleutnant Arvid Lenz, U-1047
der_kielholer._doc_rework: T-233 (docs/BOSS_REWORK.md 4.1, docs/boss_rework/w3_totenhafen.md): the boss rework. dread: the kit's presence block (iron surface, a lead-soled stomp with a 0.4 view shake). tide_under_mult / tide_ripple_mult: at high and spring tide he is under for that share of submerge_seconds and the ripple lasts that share of ripple_seconds (never under 1.0 s): the surfacing is faster as well as closer and quicker. grab.dunk_*: once the held player has been at the water's edge for dunk_after s he pushes them under for dunk_seconds (dunk_damage once, the screen under water); the break-free rules run through it and max_hold is unchanged, so every grab still breaks in solo. squad: he hunts the lone wader: a player within lone_edge_m of a water edge with no teammate within lone_mate_m, inside lone_range and in sight, is his target over the nearest. drip_seconds: how long he drips after surfacing.
